title: Using singular demonstratives without a noun
focus: Let tämä, tuo, or se stand as the complete noun-like subject.

exercises.instruction: Write the complete sentence in Finnish.
exercises.prompt: Write “That is new.” in Finnish. While comparing two photos. No noun follows the demonstrative. Use uusi (“new”). The referent is already identifiable from the conversation.
exercises.explanation: Se stands independently as the subject; no noun is needed after it.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: independent demonstrative subject + linking verb + description
